name: t097_death
_note: T-097: staged death in the OW start room. The stage writes exactly NES Link_BeHarmed @HandleDied (Z_01.asm:5756): HeartValues & $F0, EndGameMode (IsUpdatingMode/GameSubmode 0), HeartPartial 0, ObjState 0, GameMode $11, ObjDir 4. Then idle through UpdateMode11Death to the mode 8 continue question.
stages:
wr(0x66F, rd(0x66F) & 0xF0)
wr(0x11, 0)
wr(0x13, 0)
wr(0x670, 0)
wr(0xAC, 0)
wr(0x12, 0x11)
wr(0x98, 4)
log(string.format('death stage hearts=%02X gm=%02X', rd(0x66F), rd(0x12)))
